verdicts.reason: A uses a proper left-to-right banner flow with a strong headline and CTA, but 'Sparkling botanicals' is shrunk to tiny type and stranded at the bottom-left far from the headline. The can is shrunk until its label is illegible, and the gaps between can, headline and CTA look arbitrary. B keeps headline, subcopy and CTA grouped in one right-hand column, but it is essentially the square layout shrunk onto the wider canvas. The headline is undersized, breaks with an orphaned 'light', a large dead gap separates the can from the text, and the wordmark is tiny.
